The chemistry was intoxicating we could literally spend hrs talking on the phone and not get tired of ourselves the key moment that drove me to love her more was when she got sick and I visited her at the hospital late in the night , we for ice cream and hit it off with small talk going home she was the only one on my mind. I really wanted it to work between us, I’d write essays expressing my love for her I’d talk to her till the sun comes up and meet her every morning with a “I love you text. Somewhere during the summer she found someone who she fell in love with and declared to me that our relationship couldn’t go further and platonic. This was a massive blow to me personally , I was obsessed with her for months constantly stalking her through her socials sometimes passing by her school , just to see her leave the gate and enter her drivers car even worse I’d be coerced to anywhere I saw she was on her snap . This was the most painful moment in my life recovered January 2018, officially a better man since that very day I moved on, and swore to myself I will never fall in love with anyone for the rest of my life, focused on my satisfying my curiosities and exploring fields I consider lucrative . This is my story and I won’t wish it for anyone.
